facts.business: Mahalaxmi Rubtech Limited manufactures and markets polymer-based technical textiles and rubber products, including offset rubber printing blankets, technical coated fabrics, and digital print media.
key_risks: Import reliance for specialized machinery and high-performance raw materials
Niche market limiting economies of scale
Complex recycling challenges due to polymer blends
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements.
